communal first saturday coach to knock – saturday, 28th november. join us for the first saturdays conference in knock, sharing our lady’s messages of fatima and praying together for peace in the world. speakers include fr jamie twohig, fr leon (medjugorje), fr philip kemmy, fr john keane and others. holy mass at 3pm, confession and adoration. coach fare approximately €40 per person, departing caherciveen and stopping at glenbeigh, milltown, castlemaine, farranfore, abbeyfeale and newcastle west. local lift-sharing may be available. for further details, contact siobhan

. everyone is most welcome . reflection prayer for community: heavily father, you grace each of us with equal measure in your love. let us learn to love our neighbours more deeply, so that we can create peaceful and just communities. inspire us to use our creative energies to build the structures we need to overcome the obstacles of intolerance and indifference. may jesus provide us the example needed and send the spirit to warm our hearts for the journey. amen.
